long_biography.plain_text:
A childhood encounter with an austere nursing home left Dwayne Clark determined to improve life for older residents. He entered senior living at Leisure Care, rising from community management into operations leadership, then expanded Sunrise Senior Living's western footprint as an executive vice-president.

Clark turned a notebook of care and service ideas into Aegis Living in 1997. He studied customer-focused companies outside healthcare, built an owner-operated model spanning assisted living and memory care, and made workplace culture central to the business. He remains founder, chief executive and chairman of the family-owned provider operating across Washington, California and Nevada.
